messages:
incident-bot: [P1] AUTO-PAGE -> High error rate and elevated p50/p95 latency for hosted inference in eu-west-1 since 14:02 UTC. 20% 5xxs, 300ms p95 -> 1.6s. Smart-routing reports economy tier saturation. Paging: @oncall-sre @dinesh

oncall-sre: on call, looking now. linking dashboards and logs.

alice.k: saw the same on dashboards, origin looks like a burst from a single large customer + many small spikes from free tier. KV cache hit dropped in eu-west shard.

ben_p: I can patch smart-routing policy to bias latency over cost for eu-west so premium routes get priority. Want me to do that now?

carla_ops: +1. Also consider temporary rate limits on economy tier and per-org burst caps. We should avoid a full region failover unless necessary.

dinesh: paging oncall console shows dedicated pools healthy. This is hosted multi-tenant queuing backlog on economy backends. I'll triage key traces.

eva_pm: customer impact: a subset of mid-market customers reported slow responses and a support ticket for one large customer (CUST-4021). Possibly correlated to a heavy embedding job.

alice.k: rolling log snippet from proxy: ```
WARN request_queue_delay=620ms route=economy eu-west-1 model=gptx-7b variant=quant
ERROR downstream: 502 short-circuit
```

oncall-sre: action plan proposal: 1) enforce temporary per-org 60s sliding window rate cap for economy, 2) bump premium weighting in smart routing for eu-west, 3) enable canary re-route of 5% of economy -> dedicated to soak, 4) notify support + customers. If ok I'll execute.

ben_p: ACK. I'll prepare the routing patch and a rollback command. Patch looks like: ```json
{"policy": "regional-weight", "region": "eu-west-1", "priority_weights": {"premium": 0.85, "standard": 0.1, "economy": 0.05}}
```

carla_ops: for rate limiting I'll push a temporary quota change: ```sh
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/admin/quotas -d '{"scope":"economy","per_org_qps":0.5, "burst":5}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

oncall-sre: executing in order: quotas -> routing -> canary. dinesh please watch traces, ben watch console for fallback errors, alice watch KV cache metrics.

dinesh: watching traces now. Found repeated serialization stalls in the batching queue for economy worker group. Touching quotas first.

incident-bot: change_request: quota update for scope=economy initiated by oncall-sre at 14:08 UTC. Rollback window 30m.

carla_ops: quota update applied. Observability: immediate drop in queued requests for economy.

oncall-sre: applying routing patch to bias premium weight in eu-west. ben, rolling 5%-50%-100% over 6 minutes.

ben_p: routing patch deployed to control plane (canary 5% -> ok). No elevated 500s on routing plane.

alice.k: KV cache hit warmed slightly on premium but economy still cold. p95 down from 1.6s to ~1.1s in canary traffic.

dinesh: starting 5% re-route of economy -> dedicated in eu-west. monitoring latency and token cost.

mary-support: Support update ready to send: "We've applied temporary rate limits and routed high-priority traffic to improve latency for affected customers in EU-West. Some free/economy requests may see delays or rate limits. We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes." Approve?

eva_pm: approve and send. Add note to include CUST-4021 link for case owner.

noncall-sre: canary -> 50% now. No new errors. p95 trending to 650-800ms overall for eu-west. economy errors down to 6%.

ben_p: rolling to 100% bias patch. Expect cost delta; tracking in billing metrics.

incident-bot: routing_patch: regional-weight applied at 14:20 UTC by ben_p. Change id: CP-2049123456-1.

dinesh: After full deploy, overall p95 is ~700ms, 5xxs at 2%. Economy requests still subject to quota caps; a few orgs hit the new per-org limit and saw throttles. No broader customer-facing outages.

carla_ops: moving to mitigations summary for handoff: - Quota: economy per-org caps for 30m window - Smart-routing: eu-west prioritizes premium 85/10/5 - Re-route: 100% bias on control plane, 5% of economy diverted to dedicated allowed - Observability: billing flag enabled to track additional dedicated spend - Rollback plan: revert routing patch and restore quotas if errors increase >3% in 15m

oncall-sre: preparing handoff notes to next oncall: will leave the changes in place for 30m observation. If any increase in 5xxs or p95 >1s, rollback immediately. Handing over to @dinesh for next shift in 20m.

dinesh: taking handoff. will continue to monitor for regressions and coordinate with support on escalations for any orgs that need quota exceptions.

mary-support: sent customer update. CUST-4021 acknowledged and asked for ETA; we've offered a short-term quota exception — case owner handling.

eva_pm: follow-up action items assigned: - infra/eng-runtime to investigate batching stalls and KV cache misses (alice/ben) - product to review economy tier default caps and recommend long-term changes (eva) - finance to estimate cost impact of dedicated re-routes (carla)

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> Metrics stabilized, no broad customer outage. Incident status: mitigated. Next steps: postmortem in #postmortems within 48h.

carla_ops: thanks team. I'll open postmortem doc and link runbook references.

oncall-sre: handoff complete at 14:40 UTC. leaving thread.

dinesh: ack, monitoring.
